timeline.text: Family Link never saw the PlayStation or the TV stick, and the router's own page only worked from inside the house.
It's like a guest list that skips half the house.
The only way to cut a device off was walking home and digging through router menus.
A Cloudflare Worker now talks to the router directly, listing every device with its name and today's usage.
That one tap works the same from home Wi-Fi, from a stranger's Wi-Fi, or from 5G.
